propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107+ emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when infer_model constructs openai: targets because v2 will change that prefix from Chat Completions to Responses semantics.

Rebar currently composes ambiguous openai: model targets in anthropic_model.py (_pai_model) and model_classes.py (_resolve_target), causing runtime deprecation warnings during real model construction.

ProviderSession gates for cfg.base_url builder registration and per-candidate endpoint-override matching only recognize openai, so switching to openai-chat: alone would break custom endpoint routing and profile override behavior.

All rebar-owned and legacy openai: model targets must normalize to the explicit openai-chat: qualifier across primary inference, model-class fallback resolution, and endpoint builder registration to preserve Chat Completions wire protocol while eliminating the v2 deprecation warning.
User-approved decision freezes Chat Completions semantics by adopting openai-chat: prefix; deliberate migration to openai-responses: is deferred to separate story upbeat-illadvised-springtail.
